claims.quote: We are an existing customer in partner support. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your prompt communication. This is being treated as a support incident, and our team is currently looking into the issue. Please be assured that we will resolve this before proceeding with any discussions about expansion.

In the meantime, if you have any additional details that could help us diagnose the problem, please let us know.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Position]
Cedar Systems
[Contact Information]

P.S. For any further questions or support needs, feel free to reach out directly to our support team at [support email/phone].

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Your Position]
Cedar Systems
[Contact Information]

[End of Draft]
questions: What specific configuration change caused the workflow to stop?
Have you identified any error messages or logs related to the workflow stoppage?
